# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Best overall for most people: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED's top pick is a chrome stand with a tilting iPhone pad that also works in landscape for StandBy mode. It charges an iPhone at up to 15 W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods sit on the base. WIRED lists it at $98 (list $109), and also cites $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Best if you want the fastest charging: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2, 25 W).**
- It charges at up to 25 W on iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus (needs iOS 26). It does 20 W on iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro, and 15 W on older iPhones.
- It has an active cooling fan, a 50 W adapter in the box, an Apple Watch pad and a Qi pad for AirPods.
- It lists at $99.99. Dealectric says code PARTNER18 brings it to $82.00, which it last tested on 2026-10-23. I couldn't verify that myself, and the code is for ESR's own store.
- ESR doesn't publish the stand's dimensions, so check your nightstand space first.
- [Buy the ESR CryoBoost (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). Dealectric is paid if you buy through it. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-3-in-1-qi2-charging-stand-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-review-2026))

**Other good options**
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Stand (Qi2 25 W), $129.99:** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has seen. It folds for travel and includes a 45 W adapter. It's pricey, and Macworld notes smaller, lighter rivals exist. ([Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html))
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2), about $80 on sale:** This is WIRED's best travel pick. It folds slim and charges at 15 W. WIRED notes it can feel crowded when fully loaded. ([WIRED travel chargers](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/))
- **ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station, about $40 on Amazon (list $80):** WIRED's best-cheap pick. Prices on sale items change often, so check the current price. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**How to choose:** WIRED notes that 25 W Qi2.2 isn't widely supported yet and makes little difference if you charge overnight. If you do have an iPhone 16 or 17 and want faster top-ups, the ESR CryoBoost or Satechi is the better buy. Otherwise, the Belkin or the cheaper ESR is enough.
